summary: The LoginNewProgram class is responsible for handling login activities for new HSPnet programs. It retrieves and stores program information using database procedures.
purpose: To manage login interactions for new HSPnet programs by fetching relevant data and maintaining a list of program items.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of the program, combining LongName and ShortName from the database.

fields.name: PCList
fields.description: A list of PC identifiers related to the program.

workflows.name: Populate Program List
steps: Call the stored procedure 'LoginWelcomeNewHSPnetPrograms' to retrieve data.
Read through the SqlDataReader and create ProgramItem objects.
Populate the Name and PCList fields from the database fields LongName, ShortName, and PCList.
Add each ProgramItem to the Data list.

system_behavior: The system initializes with a session and retrieves data using a stored procedure.
The retrieved data is processed to create a list of program items.
exceptions: Ensure SqlDataReader is not null before attempting to read data.
Close the SqlDataReader after data retrieval.
